name: AI Agent
category_description: AI cluster root node (agent, chain, vector store)
description: The AI Agent node lets you build an AI agent in n8n. Connect a chat model and one or more tools, and the agent decides which tools to call to complete a task

parameters.name: Human Message
parameters.description: Tell the agent about the tools it can use and add context to the user's input

parameters.name: Human Message Template
parameters.description: Enter a message that n8n will send to the agent during each step execution
options: {current_step}: Contains information about the current step
{agent_scratchpad}: Information to remember for the next iteration

parameters.name: Prefix Message
parameters.description: Enter text to prefix the tools list at the start of the conversation. You don't need to add the list of tools. LangChain automatically adds the tools list

parameters.name: Suffix Message for Chat Model
parameters.description: Add text to append after the tools list at the start of the conversation when the agent uses a chat model. You don't need to add the list of tools. LangChain automatically adds the tools list

parameters.name: Suffix Message for Regular Model
parameters.description: Add text to append after the tools list at the start of the conversation when the agent uses a regular/instruct model. You don't need to add the list of tools. LangChain automatically adds the tools list

parameters.name: Data Source
parameters.description: Choose the database to use as a data source for the node. Options include:
options: MySQL: Select this option to use a MySQL database
Also select the Credential for MySQL
SQLite: Select this option to use a SQLite database
Postgres: Select this option to use a Postgres database
Also select the Credential for Postgres

parameters.name: Ignored Tables
parameters.description: If you'd like the node to ignore any tables from the database, enter a comma-separated list of tables you'd like it to ignore

parameters.name: Include Sample Rows
parameters.description: Enter the number of sample rows to include in the prompt to the agent. Default is 3

parameters.name: Included Tables
parameters.description: If you'd only like to include specific tables from the database, enter a comma-separated list of tables to include

parameters.name: Prefix Prompt
parameters.description: Enter a message you'd like to send to the agent before the Prompt text. This initial message can provide more context and guidance to the agent about what it can and can't do, and how to format the response

parameters.name: Suffix Prompt
parameters.description: Enter a message you'd like to send to the agent after the Prompt text
options: {agent_scratchpad}: Information to remember for the next iteration

parameters.name: Limit
parameters.description: Enter the maximum number of results to return

parameters.name: Enable Streaming
parameters.description: When enabled, the AI Agent sends data back to the user in real-time as it generates the answer. This is useful for long-running generations. This is enabled by default

operation_details.summary: Use the options to create a message to send to the agent at the start of the conversation. The message type depends on the model you're using:

parameters.name: Chat models
parameters.description: These models have the concept of three components interacting (AI, system, and human). They can receive system messages and human messages (prompts)

parameters.name: Instruct models
parameters.description: These models don't have the concept of separate AI, system, and human components. They receive one body of text, the instruct message

operation_details.summary: Configure the SQL Agent using the following parameters

options.name: MySQL
options.description: Select this option to use a MySQL database

options.name: SQLite
options.description: Select this option to use a SQLite database

options.name: Postgres
options.description: Select this option to use a Postgres database

common_issues.title: A Chat Model sub-node must be connected error
common_issues.summary: This error displays when n8n tries to execute the node without having a Chat Model connected

common_issues.title: No prompt specified error
common_issues.summary: This error occurs when the agent expects to get the prompt from the previous node automatically. Typically, this happens when you're using the Chat Trigger Node

parameters.displayName: Connect an output parser on the canvas to specify the output format you require

parameters.name: fallbackNotice
parameters.displayName: Connect an additional language model on the canvas to use it as a fallback if the main model fails

options.name: systemMessage
options.description: The message that will be sent to the agent before the conversation starts

options.name: maxIterations
options.description: The maximum number of iterations the agent will run before stopping

options.name: returnIntermediateSteps
options.description: Whether or not the output should include intermediate steps the agent took

options.name: passthroughBinaryImages
options.description: Whether or not binary images should be automatically passed through to the agent as image type messages

options.name: passthroughBinaryPdfs
options.description: Whether or not binary PDF documents should be automatically passed through to the agent. Useful for models that natively support PDF input (e.g. Google Gemini).

options.name: tracingMetadata
options.description: Custom metadata added to tracing events

options.name: autoSaveHighlightedData
options.description: Whether to automatically save highlighted data.

options.name: enableStreaming
options.description: Whether this agent will stream the response in real-time as it generates text

options.name: batching
options.description: Batch processing options for rate limiting

options.name: maxTokensFromMemory
options.description: The maximum number of tokens to read from the chat memory history. Set to 0 to read all history.
